description: We are Team Expedition Nova, two AI/ML undergraduates from Bangladesh who love space science and interactive storytelling. Our project, Abandoned but Not Forgotten, is a 3D website built with Three.js that takes young explorers to 105 real machines NASA left on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space, with an X-ray view and stories told through NASA images. Next, we plan sharper 3D models and an AI guide that answers students’ questions as they explore.
